idea-plugin.name: En-Ru File Finder
idea-plugin.description:
Instantly switch between 'en' and 'ru' folders for the same file with a shortcut. Works with single or multiple file selection, preserves caret position and scroll offset.
Switching in diff view is also supported
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.4.6

  • Added the first setting under Tools > En-Ru File Finder: Open new file to choose between opening new files in a new tab or to split it to the right.
  • Notifications are divided into two groups now: En-Ru File Finder Regular and En-Ru File Finder Problems.

Version 1.4.5

  • Unified viewer support – the shortcut now also works when the diff tab uses the Unified (one-side) viewer, not only Side-by-side.
  • GitLab Merge Request diffs – supported switching from "Diff for Merge Request" tabs; the counterpart diff opens pinned to the same revisions.
  • Repository Diff – supported the combined "Repository Diff" view opened from the Git tool window's Log.

Version 1.4.4

  • Works for diff view now (from Commit tool window).
  • Preserves the state of the "Annotate with Git Blame" option in the gutter.

Version 1.4.3

  • Improved scroll sync.
  • Folder navigation – selecting a folder now navigates to its counterpart in the opposite language folder in the Project tool window instead of showing an error.
  • Missing file creation – if no counterpart file exists, the plugin now offers to create it with the same content, including any missing intermediate directories.

Version 1.4.2

  • Keep focus – the plugin now remembers the vertical scroll position and restores the exact viewport position from the original file.
  • Published on JetBrains Marketplace – the plugin is now available in JetBrains Marketplace.
  • Custom plugin icon – added a custom icon for better recognition in the IDE and Marketplace.

Version 1.4

  • Multiple file selection – now you can select several files in the Project tool window (Shift+click or Ctrl+click) and the plugin will open all their counterparts from the opposite language folder.
  • Folder detection – plugin now ignores folders; if you select a folder, it will show a clear message instead of trying to process it.
  • Caret position sync – if the original file is already open in the editor, the plugin remembers the cursor line and moves the caret to the same line in the opened counterpart file.
  • Clearer feedback – improved notification messages: you'll see how many files were opened, and any errors (e.g., missing counterpart) are listed separately.
  • Bug fixes – fixed NPE when processing files in project root, and other edge cases.

Version 1.3

  • Initial release: switch between en/ru files with Ctrl+Alt+\
